title: Economics explained
description: India's Manufacturing PMI (Purchasing Managers' Index) for July 2026 was 53.5. This number shows that factory activity is still growing, but at a slower pace .

faq.q: Who releases the Manufacturing PMI for India?
faq.a: The Manufacturing PMI for India is compiled and released by S&P Global, often in partnership with HSBC, based on surveys of purchasing managers.

faq.q: How often is the PMI released?
faq.a: The Manufacturing PMI data is released monthly, typically on the first business day of the month, providing timely insights into economic trends.

faq.q: What is considered a "good" PMI number?
faq.a: Generally, any reading above 50 is considered positive as it indicates expansion. However, a consistently high and rising PMI often signals strong economic health and momentum.

faq.q: Why do purchasing managers' opinions matter so much?
faq.a: Purchasing managers are at the forefront of a company's operations, making decisions about raw material procurement and production schedules. This gives them early insights into changes in demand and supply conditions, often before these changes are reflected in official economic data.

faq.q: Does the PMI only cover large companies?
faq.a: The survey panel is stratified by detailed sector and company workforce size, aiming to cover a representative sample of manufacturers, including both large and mid-cap firms.
